Role-based grouping for team and specialist agents.

- Producer: `workflows/ai-team/ai-team-producer.agent.md`
- Development Team: `workflows/ai-team/ai-team-dev.agent.md`
- QA Team: `workflows/ai-team/ai-team-qa.agent.md`

- `principal-software-engineer.agent.md`

- `task-planner.agent.md`

## Mode-like Roles

- `workflows/ai-team/ai-team-producer.agent.md` is both a role and an orchestrator.
- This dual classification is intentional and documented in `AGENT_REGISTRY.json`.
